projects.title: HR Employee Attrition Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Analyzed 1,470 employees to identify high-risk groups and retention factors. Discovered that Sales Representatives had 39.8% attrition and overtime workers 30.5%. Used DAX correlation analysis to uncover 5 key retention factors contributing to 16.12% overall attrition rate.

projects.title: Fashion MNIST Classifier
projects.description: Built a deep learning ML pipeline achieving 89.37% test accuracy using TensorFlow. Implemented hyperparameter tuning with Optuna (3 layers, 86 neurons) and deployed a real-time classification dashboard using Streamlit.

projects.title: IoT Smart Pet Care System
projects.description: Led a team to develop an automated pet feeding system using ESP32 with IR sensors for food detection and water level monitoring. Implemented real-time MQTT communication with Supabase and designed a Flutter mobile interface for remote control and monitoring.

projects.title: Job Market Analysis
projects.description: Processed over 8,000 job listings using automated SQL pipeline to uncover seasonal hiring trends and high-growth sectors in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Created 12 interactive visualizations with Plotly and Seaborn to present market dynamics and employer insights.
